hero.title: Voice Reports
hero.description: Talk reports into existence. Walk through a site inspection speaking your observations— AI generates a formatted PDF instantly.

intro: Traditional reports require sitting down, opening a form, and typing answers. HABOS offers four fill modes: a real-time voice interview where AI asks questions field by field, a dictation mode where a single voice note fills all fields silently, a text chatbot that walks through each field conversationally, and traditional manual input as fallback. Upload a PDF or image and GPT-4 Vision extracts field labels, types, and validation patterns to generate a typed schema automatically.

problem.title: The Report Writing Problem
problem.body: For field workers, nurses, inspectors, and many professionals, writing reports on touchscreens or computers is a massive time sink. It's slow, tedious, and people often leave out details because typing is too cumbersome. Voice Reports changes everything.

features.title: Just Talk
features.desc: Open VOIS, tap record, and talk through your observations. No typing, no forms, no checkboxes. AI listens, structures, and formats everything automatically.

features.title: Instant Formatting
features.desc: AI generates a properly formatted report—headings, sections, bullet points, summaries. Export as PDF, Word, or any format you need. It's ready to submit immediately.

features.title: 10x Faster
features.desc: People talk 3-4x faster than they type. Add in AI formatting and you're looking at 10x time savings. What used to take 30 minutes now takes 3.

features.title: Richer Information
features.desc: When reporting is this easy, people include more detail. You get better data, more context, and clearer communication—all because talking is effortless.

example.title: Example: Construction Site Inspection
steps: You arrive at the site with your phone or watch. Tap record in VOIS.

"Site inspection, Building 3, March 15th. Weather conditions: clear, 65 degrees. Foundation looks solid—no cracks visible. Electrical rough-in is 80% complete, on schedule. Plumbing issue in Unit 204—leak under the sink, needs repair before inspection. HVAC ducts installed, awaiting final connections..."
You walk and talk for 5 minutes, covering everything you see.
Stop recording. AI generates a formatted inspection report with sections, bullet points, and a summary. The plumbing issue is flagged as urgent.
Export PDF. Email to project manager. Done. Total time: 6 minutes.

integration.title: Powers Operations AI
integration.body: Voice Reports isn't just about saving time—it feeds critical data into Operations AI. When your team submits detailed voice reports, Operations AI can identify patterns, spot bottlenecks, and alert you to problems before they escalate. It's the foundation of intelligent operations management.
